_doc.arrival.components: mixture of arrival-time distributions; weight = share of orders; type uniform [from,to) or normal (mean, sd) in minutes; clamped to [0, maxArriveMinute]
_doc.games: game ids and relative order frequency
_doc.paidDelay: paid_minute = arrive + int in [min,max] (D12: always >= arrive), capped at 1439
_doc.value: value_thb = min + exponential(mean) rounded to roundTo, capped at max (skewed toward small)
_doc.sla: sla_minutes inclusive ranges for normal / vip orders
_doc.staff.shifts: each shift: from,to fixed; count drawn from inclusive [countMin,countMax]
_doc.suppliers: count; each supports gamesPerSupplier [min,max] games; costPct uniform range rounded to 0.01; outages count [min,max] with length [min,max]
_doc.suppliers.uncoveredGameProb: probability one game is left with no supplier (exercises D3b impossible orders)
_doc.wallet.totalFactor: total wallet across suppliers = factor x total cost of paid orders at cheapest supporting supplier
_doc.wallet.cheapestCapFraction: a supplier that is cheapest for game g gets wallet <= fraction x cost of all paid g orders at its price, so it cannot afford them all; excess goes to other suppliers
